payload.description:
swaggertype: the spec generator cannot resolve json.RawMessage, and the
payload really is a task-type-specific object to any client.

events.description: Events is an allowlist of exact subjects. Empty means every event.

payload.description:
swaggertype: the spec generator cannot resolve json.RawMessage, and the
payload really is an arbitrary event object to any client.

manifest.description:
Manifest is the raw plugin.yaml text. It is parsed and validated against
the finalized schema before anything is recorded.

target.description:
Target is optional. Empty restores into the agent's staging area for
inspection; "home" restores in place over the account's live data.

secret.description:
Secret is set ONLY in the create response — this is the one and only
time the plaintext signing key is shown.

name.description: FQDN (trailing dot normalised by the provider)

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, NS

events.description:
Events the plugin subscribes to (must be `events.*` subjects; see the
events package). Declares intent; the runtime will enforce it.

permissions.description:
Permissions the plugin may exercise, enforced against this list at
runtime — a plugin gets exactly what it declares, nothing ambient.

plugins.UISurfaces.description:
UI surfaces the plugin registers. Core renders these from the manifest;
plugins never edit core UI directly.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
